opening.argument: Judge, the screen presents a direct token-purchase proposition while the video discusses a possible price surge: the ApeMax banner pairs “DAILY PRICE INCREASE” with “Join Pre-Sale.” The XLM headline separately asks whether an Elon Musk investment could drive the price to $1. The banner is the clearest participation pathway here: an appreciation claim placed beside an invitation to enter a presale. Even without a guaranteed return, that pairing deserves more scrutiny than a characterization of the video as market commentary alone.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The title raises an Elon Musk investment and a $1 XLM price; the speaker says an announcement is coming tomorrow and describes the rumor as “more than just a rumor.” The description invites viewers to buy XRP through futures trading at up to 100x leverage and supplies a trading link. Imminent news, a prominent-name price narrative, and an external high-leverage trading invitation create a materially stronger solicitation context than the word “speculation” alone suggests. The uncertainty caveat matters, but it does not erase the financial action placed alongside the hype.

opening.argument: Judge, this is not merely a detached report on Stellar. The speaker reminds viewers, “we invested in XLM at just over $0.06,” calls it “the sleeping giant,” and says that on a confirmed breakout the technical target is 15.5. That language puts the speaker and audience in the position of token holders watching for gains. The discussion then turns the next day's announcement into a possible trading moment, including an “artificial run-up” and “buy the rumor sell the news.” Read together with the description's invitation to buy leveraged crypto futures, the news format functions as a route toward market participation, even though individual predictions are qualified.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the likes and shares ordinary engagement, but those requests are not the core concern. The speaker invokes the audience's prior XLM investment and lays out a conditional price target and announcement-related trading scenario. The separate XRP promotion does not prove an XLM purchase instruction, but its presence makes it harder to treat the presentation as wholly detached from trading participation.
